title: Two-sided surcharge: a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit for a 4-cycle-free bipartite edge function has at least |E| + tau - 1 gates plus one per mixing OR gate
formal_statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (s : Fin n → Bool) (T : Finset (Fin n)) (M : Finset ℕ),
  (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → s u ≠ s v) → PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.IsMinCover G T →
  (∀ k ∈ M, k < C.gates.length ∧
      (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C k).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧
      (∃ u ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.orIn n C (n + k), s u = true) ∧
      (∃ v ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.orIn n C (n + k), s v = false)) →
  G.edgeFinset.card + T.card + M.card ≤ C.size + 1
plain_statement: Let G be a bipartite graph with no 4-cycle (colour classes from a 2-colouring s), tau(G) its least vertex-cover size, and C a circuit of AND and OR gates, each reading exactly two earlier wires (so it reads only earlier wires), computing G's edge function. Call an OR gate mixing if the inputs reaching it through OR gates only (an AND gate reaches nothing this way) include a vertex of each colour class. For every set M of mixing OR gates, |E| + tau(G) + |M| <= |C| + 1, that is, |C| >= |E| + tau - 1 + (number of mixing OR gates).
